title: 云计算与SaaS产业结构性变化分析
core_insight: 云计算领域出现多项技术和基础设施更新，包括AWS、Google Cloud、Microsoft Azure和Cloudflare的创新应用和安全方面的推进，表明云厂商在技术创新和安全方面持续推进

dimension_texts.technology: AWS推出MicroVMs，Google Cloud的Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform和Microsoft Azure的Frontier模型系列展示了云原生和AI的融合进展 Google Cloud的BigQuery和IAM数据管理标签的更新提高了数据安全性，AWS Certificate Manager支持ACME协议，自动化公钥证书的发行和更新 AWS Lambda introduces MicroVMs Level Up Your Column-level Security: Using IAM Data Governance Tags in BigQuery 13 hands-on demos to build on Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform Automate public TLS certificate issuance with ACME support in AWS Certificate Manager Meet Brain: The AI system behind Azure reliability Introducing Precursor: detecting agentic behavior with continuous client-side signals
dimension_texts.infrastructure: AWS推出新型实例C9g和C9gd，采用Graviton5处理器，提供更高的计算性能 AWS CloudFormation Express模式加速了基础设施部署速度，Google Cloud和Microsoft Azure的芯片和GPU供应的更新 Amazon EC2 C9g and C9gd instances powered by AWS Graviton5 processors are now available Accelerate your infrastructure deployments by up to 4x with AWS CloudFormation Express mode Azure Databricks delivers proven business value Built to bounce back: How Azure resiliency evolved
